en: A black and white photograph showing a bustling harbor city with numerous ships docked along the waterfront and industrial cranes at work. The view is elevated, likely from a hill or cliff, overlooking tightly packed historic buildings and streets filled with vehicles. The left side of the image shows a river or canal, and the city stretches into the background with hilly terrain. The words 'GÖTEBORG Packhusplatsen' appear in the bottom left, and '1954' is printed in the bottom right.
